text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the new year and the beginning of
Nakayama
Festa's senior year...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This New Year's holiday, the two of us
are headed
for...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pshhhh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Trainer, I don't see your suitcase
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's almost time to check in at
the hotel!
What are you gonna do,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh well, guess we gotta stop!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
How d'ya like that?! Talk about a
run-of-the-mill
airport predicament! Just
gotta remember not to
lose your cool!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, you can use the VR Umalator to even
simulate being at an airport overseas.
From the sound to
the atmosphere,
everything was so realistic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're using the academy's VR Umalator
to
simulate traveling abroad.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why you're here! You
need to get
used to being abroad as
quickly as possible!
choice_data_list: Knowing about it in theory and exp...
Knowing about it in theory and exp...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm going to enter the next set of
data into the machine. Can you three
step into the
Umalator once more,
please?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's no trouble at all. All right,
let's move
onto our
next scenario.
choice_data_list: Thank you for helping out too.
Thank you for helping out, too.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! This one's from when I competed
in the
Arc! Isn't this thing wonderful?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Your face speaks for itself! Let's
go walk
around the track!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... so this is French turf, huh? It
feels
completely different.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
It's kinda similar to the turf I used
to run
freestyle races on back in the day.
choice_data_list: Do you think you can handle it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
France does a great job making use of
the natural
landscape in its racecourses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice my feet sink into the ground as I
walk. It
feels like the earth is gently
clinging to my feet.
choice_data_list: Even the turf really is different...
Even the turf really is different,...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I realize how naive I was to believe that
training at Tracen Academy with its
well-maintained
facilities alone would be
enough to prepare her.
choice_data_list: (...We can't prepare for this on t...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If you want to compete overseas, you'll
have to
understand the local terrain and
vigorously adapt
to its environment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The experience El Condor Pasa shared
with me is
something I could have never
gained on my own
as a newcomer.
choice_data_list: (I need to think of a different tr...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how much of this information
I'll be able
to master in the time we've
got.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Vamos! What kind of training are we
starting
with?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! I like your perspective! Food
should never
be neglected!
choice_data_list: Could you tell me about the local ...
Can we do tandem training here?
I'd like to take a light stroll ar...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Eating delicious food will lead to a
happy life!
Just as unpalatable food will
bring you to tears...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
With it being a racecourse and all, the
food
options here should be pretty
good, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Don't expect to find your favorite, offal
stew,
though!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, duh. Obviously.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But, Paris is full of fantastic food!
Lemme
give
you a full rundown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we explore the area around the

racecourse, checking out the food on
offer in the
hotels and food stalls.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Claro! We are at a racecourse, after all!
Let's call
in someone for you to go
against. Graaass!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Poof!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Sirius.
You look grouchy as
per
usual.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? No cocky comeback? That's odd of
you...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I asked Grass to turn her speech
setting off!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sirius is always yapping about something
or the
other... She can kinda get on my
nerves.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Haha... That's pretty brutal, El.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we spend a short time testing
out the
French turf.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Not a bad idea. Let's take a look around
first.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! The path unknown is a
path... better off known! I'll show you
the way to the waiting
room while we're
at it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is there a dirt course in here? I
mean, the
construction is completely
different than
anywhere in Japan, so...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'll just take a quick look.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! N-Nakayama! Please, don't go off
on your
own!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suppose the novelty of this experience
has
gotten Nakayama Festa pretty
excited too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People can act out of character when
they're in unfamiliar environments.
Perhaps that even
applies to someone as
cool-headed as her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we continue taking a look
around the
racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pshhhh...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back. Was it a good
experience?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yup! And now I'm pooped! Grass, let's
go grab
some amazake!
choice_data_list: Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I like the sound of that. Mind if I
join you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, seems like you're all in need of a
sugary
pick-me-up. Care to join us too,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
How about we all go and make a New
Year wish
together?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now you're talking! Let's make a stop at
some of the food stalls selling hot dogs
and cotton candy
while we're at it!
Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, El.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. She's a very honest and
straightforward
person. That's where her
inner strength comes
from.
choice_data_list: She really is full of energy.
She's so full of energy, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That being said, I have a favor to ask
you two,
Nakayama... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El is genuinely placing her faith in you.
That's why
she's doing all this to help
you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
She'll sometimes give you the facts
straight without any sugar coating. When
she does, please take her words into
consideration. It won't be out of spite,
but rather hope.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Uh... Yeah, sure thing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you.
